newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Banks propel Estonian bourse to new highs.
newsitem.headline: Banks propel Estonian bourse to new highs.

text.p: Hansapank and Hoiupank propelled Estonia's market to new highs on Thursday and dealers said the bourse would be volatile over the coming weeks.
Total trade on the main list was a hefty 106.4 million kroons with the Talse 1.29 percent higher to close at a record level of 356.60.

The bourse has been soaring to record highs, interrupted only by brief bouts of profit-taking, as the market in the former Soviet Union's star economic reformer responds to promising interim results and revised profit forecasts.
"The market was very volatile today, with the number of buying orders completely unexpected this morning," one dealer said.
"It is hard to say where the bourse will go tomorrow-it remains unpredictable," he added.
Hansapank led the bourse with 41.5 million kroons traded to close 0.60 kroons higher at 196.10 kroons.
"The significant thing is that Hansapank reached 200 kroons today, which is an important barrier for the stock," one trader said.
However, dealers said that resistance at the 200 kroon level is strong and the stock is not expected to go beyond that level at this time.
In Helsinki, Hansapank was traded up to 74.50 markka to close at 74 markka, one markka higher.
Buying interest in Hoiupank was strong throughout the day and dealers said it could climb higher ahead of its expected profit forecast revision.
Hoiupank was up 7.70 kroons to close at 221.45 kroons after turning over 19.5 million kroons.
On the free market, 21.9 million kroons changed hands with privatisation securities the most active stock.
The securities saw trade of 12.8 million kroons to close at 0.395 down from 0.43 kroons.
